answer: Two help-center articles mention form NW-LSE-1 and would need an update if it were retired. "Selling a car that you lease" tells customers they can sign the lease buyout authorization, form NW-LSE-1, so we can request the dealer payoff quote for them. "Getting a payoff letter from your lender" says NW-LPA-1 is for loans only and sends lease customers to "Selling a car that you lease" and form NW-LSE-1. Other lease articles I found don't name the form, including "Which leasing companies allow third-party buyouts," "If our offer is more than your lease buyout," "Selling vs. turning in at lease end" and "What to bring to your appraisal appointment."
